en: A vintage, monochrome view of a long Renaissance-style palazzo façade along a city street. The building has arched doorways, rectangular and arched windows with shutters, and fabric awnings hanging from several windows. A few pedestrians stand or walk along the sidewalk in front. At the bottom center of the image, text identifies the location as Palazzo Geremia in Trento.
